cl.x: Provide SikaRapid®-22 AU where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (February 2024, Version 01.03).
SikaRapid®-22 AU is a non chloride set and hardening accelerator for concrete, mortar and grout.

cl.t: Intended uses stated by the manufacturer
s: SikaRapid®-22 AU is recommended for use in premix and precast concrete where fast setting and hardening time is required.
As a result, SikaRapid®-22 AU allows:
▪ faster finishing of concrete surfaces
▪ improved early strength of premixed concrete
▪ faster slip-form production
▪ used in ready mix concrete in cold climates

cl.c: Data sheet page 1: Product Information > Dispensing
cl.x: SikaRapid®-22 AU is added to batching water or is poured into the concrete mix at the same time as the gauging water. SikaRapid®-22 AU may also be added into the agitator truck on site. In this case, the concrete should then be mixed for an extra 1 minute for every cubic metre of concrete. The concrete should then be checked visually for uniform consistency before discharging. Do not add SikaRapid®-22 AU to dry mix.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Product Information > Compatibility
cl.x: SikaRapid®-22 AU can be used in conjunction with any non-retarded Sika Concrete admixtures. It is beneficial to add SikaRapid®-22 AU with the initial mixing. Tests must be carried out to determine the optimum batching sequence. Do not use SikaRapid®-22 AU in conjunction with shrinkage compensating admixtures (i.e expanding agents).
Where concrete with low cement content is being supplied, higher dosage rates should be used.
Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
